title: Pause
items: Stop before you reply, click, pay or share anything.
Notice pressure: deadlines, threats, secrecy or big promises.
Notice your feelings. Fear, panic or excitement is a signal to slow down.
Remember: a genuine organization will give you time to check.

title: Prove
tagline: Verify through a channel you already trust.
items: Don't use the phone number, link or email in the message.
Contact the person or organization using details you look up yourself — the number on your card, statement or their official website.
For a "loved one" in trouble, call them back on a number you already have, or use a family code word.
Talk it through with someone you trust before acting.

title: Protect
items: Never share passwords, one-time codes (OTPs) or PINs.
Never pay with gift cards, cryptocurrency or wire transfers because someone contacted you.
Don't install apps or give remote access to someone who contacted you.
If you've already paid or shared details, contact your bank immediately and report it.
